description: Conceptual attention economics model. The Creative Director must invest viewer attention in strict proportion to editorial importance (EDITORIAL IMPORTANCE GOVERNS EMPHASIS INTENSITY).

LOW.attention_budget: Minimal sensory friction; suitable for continuous baseline communication.

MEDIUM.attention_budget: Noticeable sensory shift; demands cognitive focus on a specific proof or feature.

HIGH.attention_budget: Major cognitive and visual demand; reserved strictly for HERO moments and core offers.

governing_rule: Never deploy HIGH editorial cost techniques during minor SUPPORTING beats. Reserve peak attention investment for MAJOR and HERO moments.
